title: When Collaborative Working I need to be able to assign a message to someone

comments_data.body:
Hi, one request please :-)

Could the role be un-selected to start with please?  Plus, the button can't be clicked until a role is assigned.

Have in the role as `Pending` to start with will make it clear something still has to happen.
Closing this PR. The changes have been manually applied in this branch: `feature/edit_response_in_collab_channel_1000` in PR #1012

review_comments_data.body: Hi @lebaphi -  can you teach my why we put `Assign to` in state?  Can't we just specify it in the component props for `splitButton` ?

ahh, in case if we want to use the label dynamically, just need to add the setAssingLabel function to change it :D
```
<SplitButton
      label={assignBtnLabel}
      ....
/>
```
